title: Saving for a Microscope
subtitle: 考点：一般将来时 / save up pocket money

dialogue.t: Amy, what are you saving up for?
I am saving up my pocket money for a microscope.
How much money do you have now?
I have half of it. I have one hundred yuan.
I save ten yuan every week, so about ten weeks.

vocab: save up 攒钱 · pocket money 零花钱 · microscope 显微镜 · cost 花费 · half 一半 · week 周

questions.stem: What does Amy want to buy?
questions.why: I am saving up my pocket money for a microscope.

questions.stem: How much does the microscope cost?
How much does Amy save every week?
questions.why: I save ten yuan every week.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

questions.stem: Amy has one hundred yuan now.
questions.why: I have half of it. I have one hundred yuan.

questions.stem: The microscope costs one hundred yuan.
Amy saves some money every week.
questions.why: I save ten yuan every week.

sections.title: 三、选词填空（每词限用一次）

questions.stem: Amy is saving up her pocket ____.
Amy has ____ of the money now.

questions.why: I save ten yuan every week.
